item.title: Men's Leather Monk Strap Loafers – Smart Casual Dress Shoes
item.description: Polished yet easy to wear, the Aurelio Monk Strap Loafers bring a refined finish to smart-casual menswear. A versatile leather loafer for the office, weddings and warm-weather occasions.
